description: A checklist of Ontario Building Code, Planning Act, Fire Code and City of Toronto items to check before adding a secondary suite to a house, each with its section number. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/second-suite-requirements-checklist?building=detached&smaller=yes&units_now=1&location=basement&fuel=yes&parking=one&rental=yes

fuel.description: A fuel-burning appliance, flue, fireplace or attached garage is in or next to the suite

parking.description: Parking spaces available for the suite

smaller.description: The new unit will be smaller than the main unit

units_now.description: Dwelling units in the house now

name: second-suite-requirements-checklist
title: Second suite requirements checklist
